MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT
THIS MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT is made and entered into by and between Example Community Association, a California nonprofit mutual benefit corporation (the "Association"), and Sample Management, Inc., a California corporation (hereinafter "MANAGER").

1. SERVICES
1.1 Manager, will deliver services reasonably necessary to provide Association with management services on behalf of the Association's Board of Directors, and strictly within the scope of this agreement.
1.2 Manager shall prepare and deliver to the Board monthly financial statements within fifteen (15) days after the end of each month.
1.3 Manager shall prepare a draft agenda for each regular meeting of the Board and deliver it to the Board at least seven (7) days before the meeting.
1.4 Manager shall have no Page 3 of 22 Version 3.33 BK, Revised 1/1/2022 authority to execute or enter into contracts on behalf of the Association unless specifically directed to do so by Board resolution.
1.5 Manager shall not be obligated to attend meetings on weekends or holidays or for more than two (2) hours for any single meeting.
1.6 Manager will endeavor to make helpful suggestions; however, the final decision in establishing standards, specifications and criteria shall be the Board's.
1.7 Manager is specifically not responsible for the quality of work performed by any vendor hired by the Association.

2. RECORDS
2.1 Manager shall maintain the Association's records at Manager's office and shall deliver all records to the Association within thirty (30) days after this Agreement ends.

3. FEES
3.1 Association shall pay Manager a monthly fee of $1,500, due on the first day of each month.
3.2 Manager may adjust the fees in its sole discretion upon sixty (60) days written notice to the Association.

4. TERM AND TERMINATION
4.1 This Agreement shall commence on January 1, 2026 and continue for one (1) year, and shall renew automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the term.
4.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon ninety (90) days written notice.

5. INDEMNITY
5.1 Association shall indemnify and hold Manager harmless from all claims arising out of the performance of this Agreement, except those caused by Manager's gross negligence.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have executed this Agreement.
ASSOCIATION: Example Community Association   By: ____________________ President
MANAGER: Sample Management, Inc.   By: ____________________ Its: Chief Executive
